issues.current_text: A OpenAI pausou o projeto Stargate no Reino Unido por custos de energia e incerteza sobre direitos autorais
issues.previous_text: A OpenAI pausou o projeto Stargate no Reino Unido, sua grande aposta britânica de infraestrutura de IA, citando o custo alto de energia e o ambiente regulatório do país. A meta original era instalar 8.000 processadores da Nvidia em Cobalt Park, no nordeste da Inglaterra
issues.suggestion: This is the same story from two days ago with no meaningful new development. The only new angle is the three leaders migrating to Meta — keep that detail and cut the Stargate UK rehash, or just reference it as 'após a pausa no Stargate UK, noticiada na quarta'.

issues.current_text: a Alibaba revelou ser a criadora do HappyHorse-1.0, modelo que havia sido submetido anonimamente e liderou os rankings da Artificial Analysis... A revelação chega quando a OpenAI descontinuou o Sora e a ByteDance pausou o Seedance 2.0
issues.previous_text: o HappyHorse-1.0, modelo de geração de vídeo que vinha liderando anonimamente o ranking cego da Artificial Analysis — à frente do Seedance 2.0, da ByteDance, dona do TikTok —, é obra da própria Alibaba
issues.suggestion: The Alibaba/HappyHorse reveal was already covered April 9. The Sora discontinuation and Seedance 2.0 pause due to Hollywood copyright disputes are genuinely new — lead with those and just reference the HappyHorse reveal as context ('o HappyHorse da Alibaba, revelado esta semana').

issues.current_text: O vice-presidente americano JD Vance chegou a Islamabad com Jared Kushner para negociações de paz com o Irã mediadas pelo Paquistão. O presidente do parlamento iraniano, Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, exigiu cessar-fogo no Líbano e liberação de ativos congelados como pré-condição.
issues.previous_text: Negociações presenciais estão marcadas para sábado em Islamabad, com o vice-presidente JD Vance diante do presidente do parlamento iraniano, Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf.
issues.suggestion: April 10 previewed this exact meeting. The new details (Kushner present, ceasefire in Lebanon as pre-condition, Trump threatening escalation) are genuinely new — reframe as continuation: 'As negociações que começaram sábado em Islamabad' rather than presenting the arrival as news.

issues.current_text: O Estreito de Ormuz segue praticamente fechado — 68 petroleiros presos no Golfo Pérsico e apenas 22 navios desde o cessar-fogo, contra mais de 100 por dia antes da guerra.
issues.previous_text: nas primeiras 24 horas, apenas um petroleiro e cinco navios de grãos cruzaram o Estreito de Ormuz, passagem que normalmente recebe 140 navios por dia.
issues.suggestion: Hormuz blockade has been covered daily since April 8. The updated ship counts (68 tankers stuck, 22 ships total) are new data but the framing is identical. Consider folding the Hormuz update into the inflation paragraph — the CPI data IS the new angle on the energy crisis, not the ship count.

issues.current_text: Zuckerberg prometeu até US$135 bilhões em investimentos de capital este ano
issues.previous_text: A Meta planeja gastar entre US$115 e US$135 bilhões em investimentos de capital em 2026 — quase o dobro de 2025.
issues.suggestion: Same capex figure from April 9. Cut it or just say 'Meta, que planeja investir até US$135 bi este ano' as brief context for why leaders are migrating there — don't present as news.

issues.previous_text: provedora de nuvem que hospeda centenas de milhares de processadores gráficos da Nvidia
issues.suggestion: CoreWeave has been described as 'provedora de nuvem' in three consecutive editions. By now readers know what it is. Consider just 'a CoreWeave' with no descriptor, or a different angle like 'a maior fornecedora de GPUs sob demanda'.

issues.current_text: A corrida por infraestrutura de IA ganhou três capítulos em um dia.
issues.previous_text: Multiple editions lead with infrastructure deals as the organizing frame (April 9: Meta+CoreWeave+Alibaba data center; April 10: Amazon chips + TSMC revenue; April 8: Intel Terafab + Core Scientific)
issues.suggestion: Four consecutive editions have opened with or heavily featured 'AI infrastructure race' framing. The CoreWeave/Anthropic deal is real news, but find a different entry point — maybe the Ramp data showing Anthropic overtaking OpenAI in spend share, which is a genuinely fresh angle for the opening.

issues.current_text: plataforma independente de avaliação de modelos
issues.previous_text: ranking independente do setor (April 9), benchmark de engenharia de software (April 8)
issues.suggestion: Artificial Analysis has been explained as 'independent ranking/platform' three times. Readers know it by now. Just say 'da Artificial Analysis' without the descriptor.

summary: High repetition: Stargate UK pause and HappyHorse reveal are reruns from April 9; Hormuz/Islamabad negotiations are day-4 of the same thread with identical framing; infrastructure-race opening has been used four days straight.
